verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state functions can be written in TypeScript, Python, or Go with 'steps built in' and shared backend infra (queueing, scaling, concurrency, retries) — evidence of multi-language support (inngest-docs-24). However, all other detailed feature docs (testing, versioning, AI orchestration, step tooling) and community feedback (inngest-comm-3, inngest-comm-9) reference only the TypeScript SDK, giving no confirmation of true feature parity across Python/Go SDKs. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation or examples showing Python/Go SDKs support the same step primitives, testing tools, and AI orchestration features as TypeScript, and independent community validation of non-TS SDK usage.
